types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.AffiliateShare
types.doc:
AffiliateShare credits one affiliate vault, a sub-account the broker owns,
 with a fee charged on top of the service and broker fees.

fields.name: account_id
fields.doc:
Public sub-account ID of an active affiliate vault of the broker
 (QuickSwapBrokerService.CreateAffiliateVault). Create the vault first: an
 unknown, disabled or other broker's vault, or the default vault, fails
 with AFFILIATE_VAULT_UNKNOWN; an ID that is not a public sub-account ID
 fails with FEES_INVALID.

Public ID. ConnectRPC carries it as fixed64 (a decimal string in JSON).

fields.name: bps
fields.doc: Fee in basis points of what each leg receives, from 1 to 300.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.AffiliateVault
types.doc:
AffiliateVault is a sub-account of the broker root, owned by the broker,
 credited with the fees of one affiliate. Affiliate vaults are never
 deleted.

fields.name: account_id
fields.doc:
Public sub-account ID of the vault; name it in AffiliateShare.account_id.

Public ID. ConnectRPC carries it as fixed64 (a decimal string in JSON).

fields.name: label
fields.doc: Broker-chosen label, unique per broker.

fields.name: status
fields.doc: Whether new QuickSwaps can name the vault.

fields.name: created_at
fields.doc: When the vault was created.

fields.name: updated_at
fields.doc: When the vault was last changed.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.AllowlistAction
types.doc: AllowlistAction is what a payout address allowlist change does.

values.name: ADD_DESTINATION
values.doc: Adds the destination to the vault's allowlist.

values.name: REMOVE_DESTINATION
values.doc: Removes the destination from the vault's allowlist.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.AllowlistChangeFailure
types.doc: AllowlistChangeFailure is why a change ended NOT_APPLIED.

values.name: TIMED_OUT
values.doc: The change could not be applied before its expires_at.

values.name: NOT_LISTED_ON_CHAIN
values.doc:
REMOVE_DESTINATION only: the destination was no longer on the
 allowlist when the change was applied.

values.name: LIMIT_REACHED
values.doc:
ADD_DESTINATION only: the allowlist already held 50 destinations on the
 destination's network when the change was applied.

values.name: REQUESTER_NO_LONGER_ALLOWED
values.doc:
The requesting member no longer held the Owner or Finance role, under
 the same grant, when the change was applied.

values.name: REFUSED
values.doc: The change was refused for another reason.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.AllowlistChangeStatus
types.doc: AllowlistChangeStatus is where a payout address allowlist change stands.

values.name: PENDING
values.doc:
Accepted and being applied on chain. A vault has at most one pending
 change.

values.name: APPLIED
values.doc:
Applied: the destination is on the vault's allowlist (ADD_DESTINATION)
 or no longer on it (REMOVE_DESTINATION). An added destination is
 payable from its VaultAllowlistEntry.payable_from.

values.name: NOT_APPLIED
values.doc:
Not applied, and never will be; failure says why. Nothing changed on
 the vault's allowlist. Request the change again to retry it.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.AssetVolume
types.doc: AssetVolume is a total amount in one asset.

fields.name: asset_id
fields.doc:
Asset, as an AssetConfig.ledger_id from
 GET /v1/chain/deposit-withdraw/config.

fields.name: amount
fields.doc: Total, in base units of 18 decimals.

fields.name: value_usd
fields.doc:
USD value of the amounts summed in amount that have one, each valued at
 the asset's USD price when it happened, as the field holding this entry
 says, in base units of 18 decimals, rounded down. Each amount is valued
 once, within minutes of happening, and never repriced, so a past period
 keeps its value. Unset when none has one; never zero for unknown.

fields.name: unvalued_count
fields.doc:
Amounts summed in amount without a USD value (one per QuickSwap for a
 volume, one per fee for a fee total), and so left out of value_usd:
 from the last few minutes, not valued by a current price in time, or
 from before USD values existed. Zero when value_usd covers all of
 amount.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.AssetWithoutDestination
types.doc:
AssetWithoutDestination is an asset a vault holds or was ever credited
 in, which its rule pays no destination for, so no run pays it out in kind.

fields.name: asset_id
fields.doc:
Asset, as an AssetConfig.ledger_id from
 GET /v1/chain/deposit-withdraw/config.

fields.name: balance
fields.doc:
The vault's settled balance of the asset now, as ListVaultBalances
 reports it, in base units of 18 decimals; zero when everything it was
 credited has left the vault.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.Broker
types.doc: Broker is a broker org.

fields.name: name
fields.doc: Broker name: the immutable identifier used in every request.

fields.name: display_name
fields.doc: Display name.

fields.name: enabled
fields.doc:
Whether the broker may quote and create QuickSwaps. A disabled broker
 keeps reads, vaults, keys and members.

fields.name: root_account_id
fields.doc:
Public account ID of the broker's root account.

Public ID. ConnectRPC carries it as fixed64 (a decimal string in JSON).

fields.name: default_vault_account_id
fields.doc:
Public sub-account ID of the default vault, credited with every broker
 fee (FeeKind BROKER); affiliate fees go to affiliate vaults.

fields.name: max_affiliate_vaults
fields.doc:
Affiliate vaults the broker may create, active and disabled together.
 At the limit, CreateAffiliateVault fails with RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED /
 BROKER_LIMIT.

fields.name: role
fields.doc: The caller's role; BROKER_ROLE_UNSPECIFIED for a broker API key.

fields.name: quote_rps
fields.doc:
Quote requests per second allowed for each API key of the broker, which
 is also the burst. Over the rate, QuoteQuickSwap fails with
 RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED / BROKER_LIMIT and a Retry-After header.

fields.name: create_rps
fields.doc:
Create requests per second allowed for each API key of the broker, which
 is also the burst. Over the rate, CreateQuickSwap fails with
 RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED / BROKER_LIMIT and a Retry-After header.

fields.name: read_rps
fields.doc:
Read requests per second allowed for each API key of the broker, which is
 also the burst. GetQuickSwap and every QuickSwapBrokerService call by an
 API key count as reads. Over the rate, the call fails with
 RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED / BROKER_LIMIT and a Retry-After header.

fields.name: max_unfunded_addresses
fields.doc:
Unfunded QuickSwaps the broker may hold at once: QuickSwaps whose
 deposit address is being issued or is still awaiting a deposit within
 its funding window. At the limit, CreateQuickSwap fails with
 RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED / BROKER_LIMIT; a deposit or the end of a funding
 window frees a slot.

fields.name: max_creates_per_hour
fields.doc:
QuickSwaps the broker may create in any rolling hour. At the limit,
 CreateQuickSwap fails with RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED / BROKER_LIMIT until the
 oldest create of the hour is more than an hour old.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.BrokerKey
types.doc: BrokerKey is a broker API key, without its secret.

fields.name: key_id
fields.doc: Public key ID: the part of the token between "qsk_" and the second "_".

fields.name: label
fields.doc: Label given at creation; empty for a key created by rotation.

fields.name: created_at
fields.doc: When the key was created.

fields.name: created_by_account_id
fields.doc:
Public account ID of the member who created the key; 0 for a key that a
 key created by rotating itself.

fields.name: rotated_from
fields.doc: Key this key replaced by rotation; empty otherwise.

fields.name: expires_at
fields.doc:
End of the key's rotation overlap; the key stops working then. Unset
 while the key works until revoked.

fields.name: revoked_at
fields.doc: When the key was revoked; unset while not revoked.

fields.name: active
fields.doc: Whether the key works now: neither revoked nor past expires_at.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.BrokerRole
types.doc:
BrokerRole is a person's role in a broker org. A broker has exactly one
 Owner.

values.name: OWNER
values.doc:
Everything, including withdrawals, payout settings and transferring
 ownership. Exactly one per broker.

values.name: ADMIN
values.doc:
Everything except withdrawals, payout settings, changing the Owner and
 transferring ownership: only the Owner and Finance withdraw or change
 payout settings.

values.name: FINANCE
values.doc:
Reads, and the payout settings and withdrawals of the broker's vaults:
 changes a vault's payout address allowlist (RequestVaultAllowlistChange),
 sets its payout rule (chain.withdraw.v1.AutoWithdrawService) and
 withdraws from it
 (chain.withdraw.v1.WithdrawService.CreateWalletTradingWithdraw), naming
 the vault as the subaccount_id. Manages no vaults, keys or members.

values.name: AFFILIATE_MANAGER
values.doc: Creates affiliate vaults and views balances.

values.name: VIEWER
values.doc: Read-only.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.BrokerStatsSeries
types.doc:
BrokerStatsSeries is the activity of the broker's QuickSwaps, or of the
 QuickSwaps a referral partner referred (GetReferralStats), or of one
 group of them, in columns.

 A QuickSwap counts in the bucket it was created in, with its current
 status, its credited deposit and its destination payout, so a bucket's
 numbers keep moving until its QuickSwaps end. On the totals series a fee
 counts in the bucket it was charged in, as in GetFeeTotals. On a group
 series the fees charged to the group's QuickSwaps count in the bucket the
 QuickSwap was created in.

 Deposited counts the deposits credited to the QuickSwaps and taken in for
 execution: including a deposit later found ineligible and returned,
 excluding a deposit held for review before credit, each valued in USD
 when it was taken in, as QuickSwap.deposited_value_usd. Delivered counts
 what was paid to the destination of the QuickSwaps whose DESTINATION
 withdrawal is FINALIZED: after service, broker and affiliate fees, before
 the destination network fee, each valued in USD when it was requested, as
 QuickSwap.delivered_value_usd. A fee is valued in USD when it was charged.
 Each value is fixed once, within minutes, and never repriced, so a past
 bucket keeps its value.

 Amounts are exact, in base units of 18 decimals, each list parallel to
 GetBrokerStatsResponse.asset_ids. USD values are scaled by 1e4 (4
 decimals), summed exactly and then rounded down. A value without a USD
 value counts in unvalued_count and is left out of the USD totals.

fields.name: totals
fields.doc:
All of the broker's (or referral partner's) QuickSwaps and fees.
 Always the first series.

fields.name: route
fields.doc: The QuickSwaps of one route, for the ROUTE breakdown.

fields.name: vault_account_id
fields.doc:
Public sub-account ID of a vault, for the VAULT breakdown: the
 QuickSwaps that credited it a broker or affiliate fee. Its fees are
 the fees credited to the vault.

fields.name: source_zipped_asset_id
fields.doc:
The QuickSwaps of one source asset and network, for the SOURCE_ASSET
 breakdown.

fields.name: destination_zipped_asset_id
fields.doc:
The QuickSwaps of one destination asset and network, for the
 DESTINATION_ASSET breakdown.

fields.name: others
fields.doc:
Every group without per-bucket columns, summed. Absent when every
 group has them.

fields.name: created_count
fields.doc: QuickSwaps created in the window.

fields.name: status_counts
fields.doc:
Those QuickSwaps by current status, indexed by QuickSwapStatus number;
 trailing zero counts are omitted. The counts total created_count.

fields.name: deposited
fields.doc: Deposited per asset, parallel to GetBrokerStatsResponse.asset_ids.

fields.name: delivered
fields.doc: Delivered per asset, parallel to GetBrokerStatsResponse.asset_ids.

fields.name: fees
fields.doc:
Fees per asset, every share together, parallel to
 GetBrokerStatsResponse.asset_ids.

fields.name: deposited_usd_q4
fields.doc: USD value of deposited, scaled by 1e4.

fields.name: delivered_usd_q4
fields.doc: USD value of delivered, scaled by 1e4.

fields.name: fees_usd_q4
fields.doc: USD value of fees, scaled by 1e4.

fields.name: unvalued_count
fields.doc:
Deposits, payouts and fees summed above without a USD value, and so
 left out of the USD totals: from the last few minutes, not valued by a
 current price in time, or from before USD values existed.

fields.name: created
fields.doc:
Per-bucket columns, each GetBrokerStatsResponse.points long: set only on
 the totals series, the first 10 groups in GetBrokerStatsResponse.series
 order, the drill-down group and others; empty otherwise.
 QuickSwaps created per bucket.

fields.name: completed
fields.doc: Those QuickSwaps that are now COMPLETED, per bucket.

fields.name: deposited_usd
fields.doc: USD value deposited per bucket, scaled by 1e4.

fields.name: delivered_usd
fields.doc: USD value delivered per bucket, scaled by 1e4.

fields.name: fees_usd
fields.doc: USD value of the fees per bucket, scaled by 1e4.

fields.name: unvalued
fields.doc: Values without a USD value per bucket, as unvalued_count.

fields.name: service_fee_usd
fields.doc:
Totals series only: the fees per bucket by who they credit, USD scaled
 by 1e4. Service fees, credited to Polyester.

fields.name: broker_fee_usd
fields.doc: Broker fees, credited to the broker's default vault.

fields.name: affiliate_fee_usd
fields.doc: Affiliate fees, credited to the broker's affiliate vaults.

fields.name: referral_fee_usd
fields.doc:
Referral commissions, credited to referral partners rather than to a
 vault of the broker.

fields.name: cell_bucket
fields.doc:
Totals series only, with GetBrokerStatsRequest.include_cells: the exact
 amounts per bucket and asset, as sparse cells. Cell i is bucket
 cell_bucket[i] and asset asset_ids[cell_asset[i]]; only cells with an
 amount are listed, in bucket and then asset order.

fields.name: cell_asset
fields.doc: Index into GetBrokerStatsResponse.asset_ids of each cell.

fields.name: cell_deposited
fields.doc: Deposited per cell.

fields.name: cell_delivered
fields.doc: Delivered per cell.

fields.name: cell_service_fee
fields.doc: Service fees per cell.

fields.name: cell_broker_fee
fields.doc: Broker fees per cell.

fields.name: cell_affiliate_fee
fields.doc: Affiliate fees per cell.

fields.name: cell_referral_fee
fields.doc: Referral commissions per cell.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.BrokerUsage
types.doc:
BrokerUsage is the broker's current use of its limits, counted exactly as
 the limits are enforced: the next create is refused while a count is at or
 above its limit on Broker. A count can be above its limit after the limit
 is lowered. The counts are read when the request is served and can change
 right after with concurrent creates, deposits and expiring funding windows.

fields.name: unfunded_addresses
fields.doc:
Unfunded QuickSwaps held now, counted against
 Broker.max_unfunded_addresses.

fields.name: creates_last_hour
fields.doc:
QuickSwaps created in the last hour, counted against
 Broker.max_creates_per_hour.

fields.name: affiliate_vaults
fields.doc:
Affiliate vaults created, active and disabled together, counted against
 Broker.max_affiliate_vaults.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.ChargedFee
types.doc:
ChargedFee is a fee charged on a QuickSwap in one asset, from settled
 fills and bridge payouts, summed per kind and credited account.

fields.name: kind
fields.doc: SERVICE, BROKER, AFFILIATE or REFERRAL.

fields.name: account_id
fields.doc:
Public sub-account ID of the credited vault: the default vault for
 BROKER, the affiliate vault for AFFILIATE; zero for SERVICE, credited
 to Polyester, and for REFERRAL.

Public ID. ConnectRPC carries it as fixed64 (a decimal string in JSON).

fields.name: asset_id
fields.doc:
Asset credited, as an AssetConfig.ledger_id from
 GET /v1/chain/deposit-withdraw/config.

fields.name: amount
fields.doc: Amount charged, in base units of 18 decimals.

fields.name: value_usd
fields.doc:
USD value of amount, each fee summed in it valued at its asset's USD
 price when it was charged, in base units of 18 decimals, rounded down.
 Each fee is valued once, within minutes of being charged, and never
 repriced. Unset while any fee summed in amount has no USD value: one
 charged in the last few minutes, one no current price valued in time,
 or one charged before USD values existed; never zero for unknown.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.CheckReferralCodeRequest
types.doc: CheckReferralCodeRequest asks whether the caller may take a code.

fields.name: code
fields.doc: The code; letters are compared case-insensitively.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.CheckReferralCodeResponse
types.doc:
CheckReferralCodeResponse answers for the code. The answer can change
 before SetReferralCode if another partner takes the code first.

fields.name: code
fields.doc: The code in lower case; empty when it is CODE_INVALID.

fields.name: availability
fields.doc: Whether the caller may take it.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.CreateAffiliateVaultRequest
types.doc:
CreateAffiliateVaultRequest creates, or returns, the affiliate vault with a
 label.

fields.name: broker
fields.doc: Broker name. A broker API key may name only its own broker.

fields.name: label
fields.doc:
Label, 1 to 64 characters without leading or trailing whitespace, unique
 per broker. The same label always returns the same vault.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.CreateAffiliateVaultResponse
types.doc: CreateAffiliateVaultResponse returns the vault.

fields.name: vault
fields.doc: The vault.

fields.name: created
fields.doc: Whether this request created it.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.CreateKeyRequest
types.doc: CreateKeyRequest creates a broker API key.

fields.name: broker
fields.doc: Broker name.

fields.name: label
fields.doc:
Label, 1 to 64 characters without leading or trailing whitespace,
 Unicode spaces such as the no-break space included.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.CreateKeyResponse
types.doc:
CreateKeyResponse returns the key and its token. The token is shown only
 here and cannot be recovered.

fields.name: key
fields.doc: The key.

fields.name: token
fields.doc: Bearer token qsk_<key id>_<secret>. Store it as a server secret.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.CreateQuickSwapRequest
types.doc:
CreateQuickSwapRequest creates, or returns, the QuickSwap for one
 idempotency key.

cel.message: refund_zipped_asset_id and refund_address must be set together, and refund_memo requires refund_address
broker_bps and the affiliates' bps must total at most 300
referral_code cannot be combined with affiliates

fields.name: idempotency_key
fields.doc:
Broker-chosen idempotency key, 1 to 128 characters of letters, digits,
 '.', '_', ':' or '-'. Scoped to the authenticated broker and retained
 permanently. The same key with the same request returns the same QuickSwap
 and deposit address; with a different request it fails with
 IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT. Requests are compared after every valid address and
 memo is put in its network's canonical form, so the same address in
 another case or encoding is the same request; affiliate order is
 ignored; every other field, the fees included, must be equal.

fields.name: terms
fields.doc: Economic terms.

fields.name: destination_address
fields.doc:
Recipient of the swap output on the destination network, in its native
 text form without memo: 1-256 UTF-8 bytes.

fields.name: destination_memo
fields.doc:
Destination tag or memo for destination_address. Required when the
 destination network requires one, optional when supported, and empty when
 unsupported. See ChainConfig.memo_requirement. At most 128 UTF-8 bytes.

fields.name: return_address
fields.doc:
Recipient of returned source funds on the source network, in its native
 text form without memo: 1-256 UTF-8 bytes. Deposits that are not
 accepted, and source funds that are not traded, go here; never to an
 observed sender.

fields.name: return_memo
fields.doc:
Destination tag or memo for return_address. Required when the source
 network requires one, optional when supported, and empty when unsupported.
 See ChainConfig.memo_requirement. At most 128 UTF-8 bytes.

fields.name: refund_zipped_asset_id
fields.doc:
Refund route for the intermediate asset of a two-leg route: an
 AssetChainVariant.zipped_asset_id of the asset whose AssetConfig.ledger_id
 is the quote's intermediate_asset_id in GET
 /v1/chain/deposit-withdraw/config, for example USDT on Ethereum. Required
 with refund_address when the route has an intermediate asset; optional
 and unused otherwise.

fields.name: refund_address
fields.doc:
Recipient of refunded intermediate asset on the refund route's network,
 in its native text form without memo. At most 256 UTF-8 bytes.

fields.name: refund_memo
fields.doc:
Destination tag or memo for refund_address. Required when the refund
 network requires one, optional when supported, and empty when unsupported.
 See ChainConfig.memo_requirement. At most 128 UTF-8 bytes.

fields.name: source_wallet
fields.doc:
Optional source wallet the end user will deposit from, for brokers that
 know it in advance. It must be a valid address on the source network, at
 most 256 UTF-8 bytes, and is shown on the QuickSwap. It is risk screened
 before the deposit address is issued: a wallet that fails screening
 makes the QuickSwap REJECTED, bound to the key, without a deposit
 address, and the request and every repeat of it fail with
 SOURCE_WALLET_REJECTED. Source wallets are screened in advance on
 Bitcoin, Solana and most EVM networks. Wallets on other networks,
 including the Bitcoin and Solana test networks, and wallets whose
 screening is unavailable at the time, get their address without it.
 Every deposit is still screened on arrival, so a deposit sent from
 another wallet is judged on its own sender.

fields.name: affiliates
fields.doc:
Affiliate fees, each charged on top and credited to its affiliate vault:
 at most three distinct vaults. Fixed at creation with broker_bps.

cel.message: each affiliate vault may be named once

fields.name: broker_bps
fields.doc:
Broker fee in basis points of what each leg receives, charged on top of
 the service fee and credited to the broker's default vault; 0 for none,
 at most 300. broker_bps and the affiliates' bps total at most 300.

fields.name: referral_code
fields.doc:
Optional referral partner code from a referral link, case-insensitive,
 at most 64 bytes; empty for none. Only a broker with a referral program may send one
 (REFERRAL_NOT_SUPPORTED otherwise), never with affiliates.
 It must be a valid code (REFERRAL_CODE_INVALID) that is a partner's
 code (REFERRAL_CODE_UNKNOWN), and the partner must be active
 (REFERRAL_PARTNER_INACTIVE). A code the partner has since replaced with
 SetReferralCode keeps crediting that partner. The program's current rates
 for the route are applied (quote.referral) and fixed at creation. It is
 part of the request: the same idempotency_key with another code, or with
 and without one, is IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.CreateQuickSwapResponse
types.doc: CreateQuickSwapResponse returns the QuickSwap bound to the idempotency key.

fields.name: quick_swap
fields.doc:
The QuickSwap, normally AWAITING_DEPOSIT with deposit_instructions. A
 retry returns its current state with the original quote and address.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.Deposit
types.doc: Deposit is one deposit detected on the QuickSwap's deposit address.

fields.name: index
fields.doc:
Zero-based position in deposits, which lists deposits oldest first. Not
 stable: a deposit detected earlier can appear later, for example a
 dropped or replaced deposit that confirms after all, and then shifts the
 index of every deposit after it. Identify a deposit by tx_hash with
 tx_occurrence_index, not by index.

fields.name: tx_hash
fields.doc: Source-network transaction identifier in the network's native text form.

fields.name: tx_occurrence_index
fields.doc: Output or log index of the deposit within tx_hash; zero is valid.

fields.name: zipped_asset_id
fields.doc:
Asset and network actually received, as a zipped_asset_id. Zero until
 Polyester has identified the deposit's asset, shortly after detection,
 and when the asset is not a supported route.

fields.name: amount
fields.doc:
Received amount, before the deposit network fee, in zipped_asset_id's
 token units; unset while zipped_asset_id is zero.

fields.name: disposition
fields.doc: What this deposit may do.

fields.name: reason
fields.doc:
Why the disposition is RETURN_ONLY or ON_HOLD; REASON_UNSPECIFIED
 otherwise, and for a deposit ON_HOLD for review without a more specific
 reason.

fields.name: confirmations
fields.doc:
Current source-network confirmations; zero until the source network
 reports any. Never decreases.

fields.name: required_confirmations
fields.doc: Source-network confirmations required before credit; zero until known.

fields.name: detected_at
fields.doc:
When the deposit was first seen. Eligibility compares this time with
 funding_expires_at.

fields.name: credited_at
fields.doc:
When the deposit was credited; unset until credited. Credit does not
 decide eligibility: a credited deposit can still be EVALUATING, and one
 then found ineligible, such as a late deposit, stays credited and is
 returned (RETURN_ONLY).

fields.name: flow_id
fields.doc:
Public, URL-safe lifecycle flow identifier of this deposit, usable with
 GET /v1/chain/flows/{flow_id}; empty until the flow exists. Lifecycle flow
 amounts are 18-decimal unified units (amount_e18), not token base units.

fields.name: direct_return
fields.doc:
Direct return to return_address of a deposit that was never credited: a
 RETURN_ONLY deposit that reached the address after its one eligible
 deposit, after its funding window or after the address retired. Unset
 until a direct return is recorded, and on every other deposit, which is
 returned through withdrawals.

fields.name: network_fee
fields.doc:
Deposit network fee that Zipper withheld from this deposit when it
 took the deposit in, in zipped_asset_id's token units; zero when it
 charged none. Unset until Zipper has taken the deposit in, and on a
 deposit it never takes in: a deposit returned or transferred out
 without being credited, whose deductions are not reported.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.DepositAddressState
types.doc: DepositAddressState is the lifecycle state of a QuickSwap deposit address.

values.name: ACTIVE
values.doc: The address accepts the first eligible deposit.

values.name: REFUND_MODE
values.doc:
Entered on the first confirmed deposit. Any further deposit is returned
 or held and never executes. Ends at address_retires_at. An address that
 expires unfunded goes from ACTIVE straight to RETIRED.

values.name: RETIRED
values.doc:
The address is retired. A deposit sent to it is not processed
 automatically; it is handled only through support-assisted recovery, and
 recovery is not guaranteed.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.DepositDisposition
types.doc: DepositDisposition is what a detected deposit is allowed to do.

values.name: EVALUATING
values.doc:
Detected; eligibility is being evaluated. A deposit can already be
 credited (credited_at) while it is evaluated.

values.name: ELIGIBLE
values.doc:
The eligible deposit that confirmed first. It consumed the QuickSwap and
 is the only deposit that can execute.

values.name: RETURN_ONLY
values.doc:
Not accepted: it is returned to return_address and never executes. A
 deposit found ineligible after it was credited, such as a late deposit
 (LATE_DEPOSIT), one below min_deposit_amount but at least the source
 network's minimum deposit (DEPOSIT_BELOW_MINIMUM) or above
 max_deposit_amount (DEPOSIT_ABOVE_MAXIMUM), or one of the wrong
 asset or network (WRONG_ASSET), keeps credited_at and is returned from its
 credit. One never credited, such as one that reached the address after
 its one eligible deposit (DEPOSIT_ADDRESS_ALREADY_USED) or after it
 retired (DEPOSIT_ADDRESS_RETIRED), is returned directly, and
 direct_return reports that return; RETURN_ONLY alone does not confirm
 that the return completed.

values.name: ON_HOLD
values.doc:
Held for review; it neither executes nor returns until released. A
 deposit blocked by its risk screen (SOURCE_SCREENING_BLOCKED) keeps this
 disposition after Zipper's compliance team transferred its funds out
 (QuickSwap CLOSED).

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.DepositInstructions
types.doc: DepositInstructions tell the end user where and until when to deposit.

fields.name: address
fields.doc: Deposit address in the source network's native text form, without memo.

fields.name: memo
fields.doc:
Destination tag or memo the deposit must carry; empty when the source
 network uses none. A deposit without it cannot be attributed.

fields.name: zipped_asset_id
fields.doc: Asset and network to deposit; equal to terms.source_zipped_asset_id.

fields.name: issued_at
fields.doc:
When the address was issued to this QuickSwap; the funding window starts
 here. After ADDRESS_UNAVAILABLE it can be long after created_at.

fields.name: funding_expires_at
fields.doc:
End of the funding window, fixed when the address is issued (currently 7
 days after issued_at). A deposit can execute only if Polyester detects it
 before this time; detection time counts, not block time, and
 confirmations may finish later. A deposit detected at or after this time
 never executes; it is RETURN_ONLY, and so is a deposit observed after
 the address retired. For an unfunded address, address_retires_at equals
 this time, so there is no separate scheduled return period. Send
 deposits well before this time. Never changes.

fields.name: address_retires_at
fields.doc:
After this time the deposit address is retired, and a deposit sent to
 it later never executes. One that Polyester records on this QuickSwap
 is listed in deposits as RETURN_ONLY (DEPOSIT_ADDRESS_RETIRED): it is
 returned to return_address when it can be, and its direct_return
 reports whether it was. One the network refuses before Polyester
 records it is not listed in deposits, and nothing on any QuickSwap
 reports it or its return; report its transaction to Polyester broker
 support with the swap_id. For an unfunded address it equals
 funding_expires_at.
 After a deposit is accepted it is provisional, a lower bound, until
 Polyester releases the deposit address, which can be shortly after the
 QuickSwap becomes terminal; from then on it is at least 7 days after all
 payouts finish. It only moves later, never earlier, and never before
 funding_expires_at.

fields.name: address_state
fields.doc: Current lifecycle state of the address.

fields.name: min_native_gas_limit
fields.doc:
Recommended gas limit, in gas units, for a native-coin deposit on EVM
 networks to succeed reliably: 250000. Polyester does not enforce it; the
 sender's wallet or exchange sets the gas limit. A gas estimate from the
 network of at least 50000 also works, but confirms more slowly. The gas
 a plain transfer needs differs by network: several layer-2 networks and
 EVM forks do not use 21000. If the limit is too low, the transfer fails
 on chain without depositing, and the network fee is still charged. Zero
 for token deposits and non-EVM networks.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.DepositReturn
types.doc:
DepositReturn is a deposit's direct return to return_address. It pays the
 return address only, never the deposit's sender, in the asset and on the
 network the deposit was received in.

fields.name: state
fields.doc: Return progress. Accept state values added later.

fields.name: tx_hash
fields.doc:
Return transaction on the deposit's network, in the network's native
 text form; set only once RETURN_COMPLETED, and then never changes.

fields.name: updated_at
fields.doc: When the return last changed state.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.DepositReturnState
types.doc: DepositReturnState is the progress of a deposit's direct return.

values.name: RETURN_PENDING
values.doc:
The return is queued or being sent. Its transaction may still be
 replaced, so none is reported yet.

values.name: RETURN_COMPLETED
values.doc:
The return reached return_address and is final on its network; tx_hash
 is its transaction. Terminal: the return never changes state again.

values.name: RETURN_HELD
values.doc:
The return is held and is not sent automatically: it was not possible
 (for example no return address, or the funds are no longer at the
 deposit address), awaits review, or was settled with support's help.
 Review can release it, and it then becomes RETURN_PENDING. The broker
 contacts Polyester broker support with the swap_id.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.EnrollReferralPartnerRequest
types.doc: EnrollReferralPartnerRequest applies to become a referral partner.

fields.name: earnings_subaccount_id
fields.doc:
Public sub-account ID of an active sub-account the caller owns, to be
 credited with the commissions. It cannot be changed later or be used by
 another partner.

fields.name: display_name
fields.doc:
Name shown for the partner, at most 64 characters. Leading and trailing
 spaces are removed; at least one other character must remain.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.EnrollReferralPartnerResponse
types.doc:
EnrollReferralPartnerResponse returns the new partner, pending review, with
 a random 8-character code.

fields.name: partner
fields.doc: The partner.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.ErrorCode
types.doc: ErrorCode is the stable machine-readable QuickSwap error code.

values.name: ROUTE_UNSUPPORTED
values.doc:
The source and destination route is not offered, or a bridge was
 requested with TWAP execution.

values.name: AMOUNT_OUT_OF_RANGE
values.doc:
The amount is outside the route's current limits. The error carries the
 limits (min_deposit_amount, max_deposit_amount) when known.

values.name: DECIMALS_MISMATCH
values.doc: An amount's decimals do not match its route's token decimals.

values.name: DESTINATION_ADDRESS_INVALID
values.doc:
destination_address or destination_memo is not valid on the destination
 network, or names a QuickSwap deposit address, which never receives a
 payout. A Polyester account's own deposit address is a valid
 destination.

values.name: RETURN_ADDRESS_INVALID
values.doc:
return_address or return_memo is not valid on the source network, or
 names a deposit address on Polyester (a QuickSwap deposit address or an
 account's own deposit address), which never receives a return.

values.name: REFUND_ADDRESS_REQUIRED
values.doc: The route has an intermediate asset and no refund address was supplied.

values.name: REFUND_ADDRESS_INVALID
values.doc:
refund_zipped_asset_id is not a withdraw route of the intermediate asset,
 or refund_address or refund_memo is not valid on its network, or names a
 deposit address on Polyester (a QuickSwap deposit address or an
 account's own deposit address), which never receives a refund.

values.name: SOURCE_WALLET_INVALID
values.doc: source_wallet is not valid on the source network.

values.name: QUOTE_UNAVAILABLE
values.doc: No price is currently available for the route; retry later.

values.name: PROTECTION_UNACHIEVABLE
values.doc:
The protection cannot be met at the current price: a min_amount_out above
 the expected output, or an order book that cannot fill the protected
 execution at the quoted prices.

values.name: ADDRESS_UNAVAILABLE
values.doc:
No deposit address is available right now. The QuickSwap (swap_id in the
 error) is kept, and its address is allocated automatically when one frees
 up. Follow it with GetQuickSwap or by repeating the request unchanged. Its
 quote stays the one priced at creation, and its funding window starts
 when the address is issued (issued_at).

values.name: IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT
values.doc: The idempotency key was already used with a different request.

values.name: SWAP_NOT_FOUND
values.doc:
No QuickSwap of this broker matches the selector; on
 QuickSwapReferralService, no QuickSwap the caller referred.

values.name: BROKER_DISABLED
values.doc:
The broker is disabled: quotes and creates are refused. Reads and
 QuickSwaps already created continue.

values.name: BROKER_LIMIT
values.doc:
A broker limit was reached: the unfunded QuickSwaps held at once, the
 QuickSwaps created per hour, the request rate of the API key or of a
 member's account, or the affiliate vaults the broker may create. Nothing
 is bound to the key. A funded or expired QuickSwap frees an unfunded
 slot; when the response carries a Retry-After header, retry after that
 many seconds.

values.name: AFFILIATE_VAULT_UNKNOWN
values.doc:
An affiliate names a vault that is not an active affiliate vault of the
 broker: unknown, not yet created, disabled, another broker's, or the
 default vault. Nothing is bound to the key; create or enable the vault
 and repeat the request.

values.name: BROKER_NOT_FOUND
values.doc: No broker with this name has the caller as its key or member.

values.name: ACTION_DENIED
values.doc: The caller's role, or a broker API key, may not perform the action.

values.name: STEP_UP_REQUIRED
values.doc:
The action needs a fresh step-up proof of the acting member in the
 X-Auth-Step-Up header, and none was sent or it was already used or
 expired. Complete an MFA challenge for fresh step-up and repeat the
 request with the new proof.

values.name: VAULT_NOT_FOUND
values.doc:
The ID names no vault of the broker: neither its default vault nor one
 of its affiliate vaults. GetVault and SetVaultStatus take affiliate
 vaults only, so they also return it for the default vault.

values.name: KEY_NOT_FOUND
values.doc: The broker has no API key with this ID, or it no longer works.

values.name: KEY_LIMIT
values.doc: The broker would have more than two working API keys. Revoke one first.

values.name: LAST_KEY
values.doc:
The key is the broker's last key that works without an expiry; create
 another key first.

values.name: MEMBER_NOT_FOUND
values.doc:
The person is not a member of the broker and has no pending invite, or
 the account does not exist.

values.name: ALREADY_MEMBER
values.doc: The person is already a member of the broker.

values.name: OWNER_IMMUTABLE
values.doc:
The Owner cannot be removed or given another role; transfer ownership
 instead.

values.name: INVITE_NOT_FOUND
values.doc: No pending invite with this ID is addressed to the caller.

values.name: FEES_INVALID
values.doc:
The fees are not valid in a way the request rules cannot check: an
 affiliate account_id that is not a public sub-account ID, or a
 referral_code whose discount and commission for the route exceed
 broker_bps. Fees that break the request rules (at most three distinct
 affiliates of 1 to 300 bps, broker_bps at most 300, all together at most
 300, no affiliates with a referral_code) fail with INVALID_ARGUMENT
 before this check.

values.name: STATS_INCOMPLETE
values.doc:
The broker stats, or the public QuickSwap statistics, cannot be read: a
 QuickSwap in the window, named by ErrorDetail.swap_id, is missing a
 record they need. Contact Polyester support with the swap_id.

values.name: ADDRESS_CONFLICT
values.doc:
The QuickSwap (swap_id in the error) cannot be issued a deposit address
 and never gets one, so nothing can be deposited to it; it is EXPIRED with
 reason DEPOSIT_ADDRESS_CONFLICT. Create a new QuickSwap with a new
 idempotency key, and report the swap_id to Polyester broker support.

values.name: REFERRAL_CODE_TAKEN
values.doc: The referral code is another partner's current code.

values.name: REFERRAL_CODE_RESERVED
values.doc:
The referral code is reserved: a brand or broker name, or a code a
 partner used before. Codes are never reused.

values.name: REFERRAL_CODE_INVALID
values.doc:
The referral code is not 4 to 16 letters, digits and hyphens, starting
 and ending with a letter or digit, without two hyphens in a row.

values.name: REFERRAL_PARTNER_NOT_FOUND
values.doc: The caller has not enrolled as a referral partner.

values.name: REFERRAL_PARTNER_EXISTS
values.doc:
The caller is already a referral partner with another earnings
 sub-account or display name.

values.name: EARNINGS_ACCOUNT_INVALID
values.doc:
The earnings sub-account is not an active sub-account of the caller, or
 another referral partner already uses it.

values.name: REFERRAL_PARTNER_DISABLED
values.doc: The referral partner is disabled; its code cannot be changed.

values.name: REFERRAL_CODE_LIMIT
values.doc:
The referral partner has used all its referral codes: a partner holds at
 most 10 codes over its lifetime, the one it enrolled with included, and
 each change retires a code for good. Its current code stays.

values.name: REFERRAL_NOT_SUPPORTED
values.doc:
The request has a referral_code, but the broker has no referral program.
 Repeat it without the code.

values.name: REFERRAL_CODE_UNKNOWN
values.doc:
The referral_code is not a referral partner's code, current or replaced.
 Repeat the request without the code.

values.name: REFERRAL_PARTNER_INACTIVE
values.doc:
The referral_code's partner is not active: not yet approved, disabled, or
 without an account its commission can be credited to. Repeat the
 request without the code.

values.name: PAYOUT_NOT_FOUND
values.doc: No payout run of the broker's vaults has this ID.

values.name: ALLOWLIST_DESTINATION_INVALID
values.doc:
The destination address is not a valid address on the destination
 chain, or the chain takes no external payouts.

values.name: ALLOWLIST_DESTINATION_EXISTS
values.doc: The destination is already on the vault's payout address allowlist.

values.name: ALLOWLIST_FULL
values.doc:
The vault's payout address allowlist already holds 50 destinations on
 the destination chain; remove one first.

values.name: ALLOWLIST_DESTINATION_NOT_LISTED
values.doc: The destination is not on the vault's payout address allowlist.

values.name: ALLOWLIST_DESTINATION_IN_USE
values.doc:
The vault's payout rule pays the destination, enabled or paused; change
 the rule before removing the destination.

values.name: ALLOWLIST_CHANGE_PENDING
values.doc:
The vault already has a pending payout address allowlist change; wait
 until ListVaultAllowlistChanges shows it APPLIED or NOT_APPLIED.

values.name: VAULT_ALLOWLIST_NOT_READY
values.doc:
The vault's payout address allowlist cannot be changed yet: its
 on-chain protection is still being set up. Retry in a few minutes.

values.name: ROUTE_SUSPENDED
values.doc:
The route is temporarily suspended: deposits on the source network or
 withdrawals on the destination network, as AssetChainVariant
 deposit_status and withdrawal_status SUSPENDED show. Quotes and creates
 are refused and nothing is bound to the key; QuickSwaps already created
 continue. Repeat the request once both are NORMAL again.

values.name: INVITE_VOID
values.doc:
The invite is void: the member who sent it has left the broker or may no
 longer grant its role. Accepting it granted nothing and cancelled it; ask
 a member who may grant the role for a new invite. Invites voided by a
 member change are cancelled by that change and answer INVITE_NOT_FOUND.

values.name: SOURCE_WALLET_REJECTED
values.doc:
The source_wallet failed risk screening. On QuoteQuickSwap nothing is
 bound. On CreateQuickSwap the QuickSwap (swap_id in the error) is
 REJECTED and never gets a deposit address, and every repeat of the
 request returns this error; the end user cannot swap from this wallet.

values.name: PAGE_TOKEN_INVALID
values.doc:
The page_token is malformed or was returned for other filters. Start
 again from the first page with an empty page_token.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.ErrorDetail
types.doc:
ErrorDetail is attached to QuickSwap errors. ConnectRPC clients receive it
 as an error detail of type swap.quickswap.v1.ErrorDetail. REST clients
 receive an application/problem+json body {type, title, status, detail,
 code, swapId, minDepositAmount, maxDepositAmount} whose code is the
 ErrorCode name, or the status name (for example INVALID_ARGUMENT) when no
 ErrorCode applies; swapId and the limits appear only when set.

fields.name: code
fields.doc: Stable error code.

fields.name: swap_id
fields.doc:
QuickSwap bound to the request's idempotency key, when one exists: for
 example the original QuickSwap on IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT, or the QuickSwap
 whose deposit address could not be allocated.

fields.name: min_deposit_amount
fields.doc:
AMOUNT_OUT_OF_RANGE only: the smallest deposit that currently quotes on
 the route with the requested protection, in source token units, whatever
 the request's basis. It moves with prices and network fees; show it as
 guidance, not a guarantee. A deposit below QuickSwapQuote.min_deposit_amount
 is returned to return_address (DEPOSIT_BELOW_MINIMUM). Unset for other
 codes and when no deposit currently quotes.

fields.name: max_deposit_amount
fields.doc:
AMOUNT_OUT_OF_RANGE only: the largest deposit that quotes, in source token
 units. Unset for other codes, when no deposit currently quotes, and for a
 bridge, whose deposit no order book bounds.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.Execution
types.doc: Execution selects how the credited deposit is traded.

fields.name: market
fields.doc: Execute immediately.

fields.name: twap
fields.doc: Execute in equal time slices.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.ExecutionProgress
types.doc: ExecutionProgress is the trading progress of a QuickSwap.

fields.name: input_amount
fields.doc: Credited amount committed to execution, in source token units.

fields.name: executed_input
fields.doc:
Source amount traded so far, in source token units. On a two-leg route
 this counts the first leg. Zero for a bridge, which trades nothing.

fields.name: output_amount
fields.doc:
Destination amount acquired so far after service, broker and affiliate
 fees and before withdrawal network fees, in destination token units. Zero for a
 bridge: its destination withdrawal pays the credit less its fees.

fields.name: intermediate_remainder
fields.doc:
On a two-leg route, intermediate asset acquired but not yet converted, in
 the refund route's token units; unset for a direct route and a bridge.

fields.name: completed_slices
fields.doc:
Completed slices: a market execution's one slice completes when
 execution finishes; a TWAP slice completes once it has traded and is
 over, so a slot that traded nothing or was skipped never completes.
 Zero for a bridge.

fields.name: total_slices
fields.doc:
Planned slices: a market execution has one once it is planned; a TWAP
 has its slice count, duration_ms over slice_interval_ms rounded up. Zero
 until then, and for a bridge, which trades nothing.

fields.name: started_at
fields.doc:
When the first slice was submitted for execution. Unset while all slices
 remain unsent, including an execution refused during planning. Planned
 slice times and the execution deadline do not imply a slice was sent.

fields.name: deadline
fields.doc:
Execution deadline frozen during planning: the planned start plus the TWAP
 duration or market execution window. A later first submission does not move
 this deadline. Funds not converted by then are refunded or returned.
 Independent of the quote validity and the funding window. Unset until
 the execution is planned, and for a bridge, which trades nothing.

fields.name: finished_at
fields.doc: When execution finished; unset while executing.

fields.name: slices
fields.doc:
Planned slices in increasing index order, at most 50. Includes future and
 active slices. Empty for a bridge, or when slices_unavailable_reason is set.
 When available and not truncated, input_traded and
 output_received sum to executed_input and output_amount respectively;
 completed entries count to completed_slices and the list has total_slices
 entries. Amounts are rounded cumulatively in index order.

fields.name: slices_truncated
fields.doc:
True when more than 50 slices exist; only the first 50 are listed.
 Totals and completed_slices still cover the entire execution.

fields.name: slices_unavailable_reason
fields.doc:
Why slice history is unavailable. When set, slices is empty and
 slices_truncated is false. Counts, execution status and withdrawals
 remain available, and so do the aggregate amounts, except that with
 PRECISION_UNAVAILABLE an amount in a token whose precision is
 unavailable is unset. Unspecified when history is available.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.ExecutionSlice
types.doc:
ExecutionSlice is one planned execution slot, including a slot that trades
 nothing. Its index and planned_at never change.

fields.name: index
fields.doc: Zero-based position in the execution's frozen schedule.

fields.name: planned_at
fields.doc: Frozen scheduled start time of this slot.

fields.name: executed_at
fields.doc: When its first order was sent; unset for an unsent slice.

fields.name: finished_at
fields.doc: When its outcome became final; unset while planned or executing.

fields.name: state
fields.doc: Current slice state.

fields.name: reason
fields.doc: Why a final slice did not trade in full; unspecified after full trading.

fields.name: completed
fields.doc:
Whether this slice contributes to completed_slices. A final market slice
 completes even if it traded nothing; a TWAP slice completes only if it
 traded source input and is over.

fields.name: input_traded
fields.doc: Source input traded, in source token units, counting only the first leg.

fields.name: output_received
fields.doc:
Destination received after all trading fees, in destination token units.
 On a two-leg route this is the second leg's output in this slot, which
 can include conversion of intermediate funds from earlier slots.

fields.name: average_price
fields.doc:
Net destination tokens per source token for this slot, rounded down to
 18 decimal places; empty when no source input traded. A two-leg slot's
 output can include conversion of funds carried from previous slots.

fields.name: second_leg
fields.doc: Second-leg conversion; unset on a direct route or a bridge.

fields.name: intermediate_carried
fields.doc:
Intermediate balance after this slot's recorded fills, including earlier
 carried funds, in the refund route's token units; unset on a direct route.
 It passes to later slots while executing, or to refund when execution ends.

fields.name: carry_reason
fields.doc:
Why intermediate funds could not be converted in this slot; unspecified
 when no conversion was refused.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.ExplorerDeposit
types.doc:
ExplorerDeposit is one deposit a completed QuickSwap executed: the
 credited deposit that funded it. A deposit that was returned or held is
 never listed.

fields.name: tx_hash
fields.doc:
Source-network transaction that sent the deposit, in the network's
 canonical text form, as GetQuickSwap reports it in Deposit.tx_hash.

fields.name: address
fields.doc:
QuickSwap deposit address the deposit was paid into, in the source
 network's canonical text form, without a destination tag or memo.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.ExplorerQuickSwap
types.doc:
ExplorerQuickSwap is the public view of one completed QuickSwap. Besides
 its assets, amounts and markets, it carries the transactions and
 addresses of its deposit and destination payout. It never carries a
 destination tag or memo, a return or refund address or transaction, the
 broker, a fee, an idempotency key or the quote. Fields may be added;
 clients ignore the ones they do not know.

fields.name: swap_id
fields.doc: Public QuickSwap identifier.

fields.name: completed_at
fields.doc: When the QuickSwap completed: its destination payout was final.

fields.name: source_zipped_asset_id
fields.doc:
Source asset and network, as an AssetChainVariant.zipped_asset_id from
 GET /v1/chain/deposit-withdraw/config.

fields.name: destination_zipped_asset_id
fields.doc:
Destination asset and network, as an AssetChainVariant.zipped_asset_id
 from GET /v1/chain/deposit-withdraw/config.

fields.name: source_amount
fields.doc:
Amount deposited, in source token units, before the deposit network
 fee.

fields.name: destination_amount
fields.doc:
Amount delivered to the destination, in destination token units, after
 the withdrawal network fee.

fields.name: legs
fields.doc:
Markets traded, in route order: one for a direct route, two for a route
 through an intermediate asset, none for a bridge, which moves one asset
 between networks without trading.

fields.name: deposits
fields.doc:
The credited deposits that funded the QuickSwap, oldest first: one in
 practice.

fields.name: withdrawals
fields.doc:
The finalized payouts to the destination, oldest first: one in
 practice. destination_amount is their total.

fields.name: source_value_usd
fields.doc:
USD value of the deposit taken into execution, fixed when it was taken
 in, as QuickSwap.deposited_value_usd: in base units of 18 decimals,
 rounded down, never repriced. Unset when it has none: not valued by a
 current price in time, or from before USD values existed; never zero
 for unknown.

fields.name: destination_value_usd
fields.doc:
USD value of what the destination was paid, fixed when its payout was
 requested, as QuickSwap.delivered_value_usd. Like source_value_usd, it
 is unset when it has none, and can be set a few minutes after
 completed_at.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.ExplorerRouteLeg
types.doc:
ExplorerRouteLeg is one market a completed QuickSwap traded on, in route
 order.

fields.name: symbol_id
fields.doc:
Numeric spot market identifier of the pair traded; resolve its symbol
 with GetSpotConfig.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.ExplorerWithdrawal
types.doc:
ExplorerWithdrawal is one finalized payout of a completed QuickSwap's
 output to its destination. A refund or return is never listed.

fields.name: tx_hash
fields.doc:
Destination-network transaction that paid the output, in the network's
 canonical text form, as GetQuickSwap reports it in Withdrawal.tx_hash.
 Like there, it can be corrected for up to 24 hours after completed_at.

fields.name: address
fields.doc:
Address the output was paid to, in the destination network's canonical
 text form (for example lowercase hex on EVM networks), without a
 destination tag or memo.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.FeeKind
types.doc: FeeKind identifies one component of a QuickSwap's fees.

values.name: SERVICE
values.doc:
Service fee of one trading leg, credited to Polyester, in basis points
 of what the leg receives: the leg's pair fee, capped by any fee ceiling
 agreed with the broker. A two-leg route has one per leg. On a bridge,
 the one bridge fee, capped the same way, in basis points of the credited
 amount, charged at payout.

values.name: BROKER
values.doc:
Broker fee of one trading leg, the request's broker_bps of what the leg
 receives, credited to the broker's default vault. A two-leg route has one
 per leg; a bridge has one, on the credited amount, charged at payout.

values.name: AFFILIATE
values.doc:
Affiliate fee of one trading leg, one affiliate's bps of what the leg
 receives, credited to that affiliate vault. Each affiliate has one per
 leg; on a bridge one, on the credited amount, charged at payout.

values.name: DEPOSIT_NETWORK
values.doc:
Network fee withheld from the deposit before it is credited. A quote
 shows an estimate; the fee withheld is the network's fee when the
 deposit arrives; Deposit.network_fee reports the fee recorded.

values.name: WITHDRAWAL_NETWORK
values.doc:
Estimated network fee for a withdrawal. The actual fee is charged at
 withdrawal time and reported on the withdrawal.

values.name: REFERRAL
values.doc:
Referral commission of one trading leg: the referral partner's
 commission_bps (ReferralPricing) of what the leg receives, credited to
 the partner. It comes out of the broker fee and adds nothing to what the
 end user pays. Only a request with a referral_code has one; it never
 appears with AFFILIATE fees. On a bridge one, on the credited amount,
 charged at payout.

values.name: RETURN_NETWORK
values.doc:
Estimated network fee withheld from a RETURN of untraded source funds

types.doc:

 Both bounds are rounded down to the minute before the read. Every time a
 referral partner sees is minute-granular, as in ListReferredQuickSwaps:
 a referred QuickSwap's exact time could be matched to its on-chain
 deposit or payout, and so to the person who swapped, and second-precise
 bounds would reveal it by narrowing the window. So a QuickSwap created in
 the window's last partial minute, the current minute when end_time is

 or later. Changes to QuickSwaps already counted show within seconds.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.ListCompletedQuickSwapsRequest
types.doc:
ListCompletedQuickSwapsRequest lists completed QuickSwaps of every broker,
 optionally only those matching every filter given. A side's filters match
 a QuickSwap whose asset and network is any of its zipped_asset_ids, or on
 any network of any of its asset_ids. The source and destination
 filters together may select at most 400 routes (source and destination
 asset and network pairs), counting each asset_id as all its networks.
 QuickSwaps created before the Explorer launched never match an asset
 filter, and those without a source_value_usd never match a USD bound.

 A USD bound is 0 or 1, 2 or 5 times a power of ten dollars from $1 to
 $1,000,000,000: $1, $2, $5, $10, $20, $50, $100 and so on. With a USD
 bound, the list holds only QuickSwaps that completed at least 5 minutes
 before it is read, when their source_value_usd is final, so it lags
 completion by up to 5 minutes. The routes times the value steps the range
 covers may be at most 400, counted from the request alone: the steps run
 $0 to $1, $1 to $2, $2 to $5, $5 to $10 and so on up to $1,000,000,000 and
 above, the last one, so a range without a maximum covers the steps from
 its minimum to the last.

fields.name: source_zipped_asset_ids
fields.doc:
Only QuickSwaps from one of these source assets and networks, as
 AssetChainVariant.zipped_asset_id values from
 GET /v1/chain/deposit-withdraw/config; at most 20.

fields.name: destination_zipped_asset_ids
fields.doc:
Only QuickSwaps to one of these destination assets and networks, as

fields.doc: Maximum number of QuickSwaps to return; 0 means 50, at most 100.

fields.name: page_token
fields.doc:

 newest-first order. Reuse it with the same filters. If a network was
 added to or removed from one of the asset IDs since the first page, it
 is PAGE_TOKEN_INVALID: request the first page again. Empty for the first
 page.

fields.name: source_asset_ids
destination_asset_ids
fields.doc:

 source_asset_ids; at most 20.

fields.doc:
Only QuickSwaps whose source_value_usd is at least this: a bound on the

cel.message: min_source_value_usd must be 0 or 1, 2 or 5 times a power of ten dollars from $1 to $1,000,000,000 ($1, $2, $5, $10, $20, $50, ...): base units 0, or 1, 2 or 5 followed by 18 to 26 zeros, or 1 followed by 27 zeros

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.ListPayoutsResponse
types.doc:
ListPayoutsResponse lists payouts newest first by scheduled slot. Runs of
 the same slot follow a stable server-defined order, the same on every
 page; it does not follow run_id. next_page_token marks a position in the
 run history, in that order. Without a status filter it is the last payout
 returned. On any page filtered by status, a full one included, the
 position can lie past the last payout returned: when the page uses up its
 scan before finding another match, it is the last run the page examined.
 A page may hold fewer than limit payouts, or none, while next_page_token
 is set and matching payouts remain; keep paging until next_page_token is
 empty. A complete traversal, followed until next_page_token is empty,
 lists every payout that matched throughout it exactly once, in order. A
 run started meanwhile past the position, for an older slot, is listed by
 a later page. A run started meanwhile at or before the position,
 including one between the last payout returned and the position, and a
 run there whose status changes meanwhile into the filter (in progress
 becoming paid, for example) appear only in a listing started again from
 the first page.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.ListReferralLedgerResponse

ListReferralLedgerResponse lists ledger entries newest first by
 occurred_at, as ListVaultLedger does: each referral commission credited to
 the earnings sub-account (FEE_CREDIT with fee_kind REFERRAL), and each
 auto-withdraw payout that left it (PAYOUT_DEBIT), with its refund
 (PAYOUT_REFUND). A credit's occurred_at is rounded down to the minute,

 refund before its debit. It carries no running balance and lists no other
 movement of the sub-account, such as a withdrawal or transfer the partner
 makes itself: read the balance and every movement with
 LedgerReadService. Paging lists exactly once every entry that sorts after the previous
 page's last entry when the next page is read. A page may hold fewer than
 limit entries while next_page_token is set; continue until it is empty.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.Payout
types.doc: Payout is one scheduled payout run of a broker vault's payout rule.

fields.name: run_id
fields.doc: Public payout run ID.

fields.name: vault_account_id
fields.doc:
Public sub-account ID of the vault paid out: the default vault or an
 affiliate vault.

fields.name: status
fields.doc: What the run came to.

fields.name: reason
fields.doc:
Machine-readable reason of the status (see PayoutStatus); empty for
 PAYOUT_PAID and PAYOUT_IN_PROGRESS.

fields.name: stage
fields.doc: Where an in-progress run stands; PAYOUT_STAGE_UNSPECIFIED otherwise.

fields.name: rule_version
fields.doc: The rule version the run executed.

fields.name: scheduled_for
fields.doc: The scheduled UTC slot the run belongs to.

fields.name: started_at
fields.doc: When the run started.

fields.name: finished_at
fields.doc: When the run ended; unset while it is in progress.

fields.name: min_usd_value
fields.doc:
The rule's least USD value of one payout, in base units of 18 decimals;
 unset when the rule has no USD minimum.

fields.name: steps
fields.doc:
One step per destination of the rule version, in asset_id order. Empty
 while the run is planning or converting.

fields.name: conversions
fields.doc:
On a rule with a payout asset, each other asset the run converts into
 it before its one payout step, in source_asset_id order; empty for an
 in-kind run and while the run is planning.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.PayoutClose
types.doc: PayoutClose is how a debited payout's withdrawal ended.

values.name: CLOSE_PAID
values.doc:
The withdrawal completed on its destination network; the destination
 received amount minus charged_network_fee.

values.name: CLOSE_REFUNDED_TO_SMART_ACCOUNT
values.doc:
The destination network's bridge rejected the withdrawal and refunded
 its net, less the network fee it kept, to the vault's own smart account;
 a PAYOUT_REFUND entry and PayoutStep.refunded_amount show the refund.
 The debit stands.

values.name: CLOSE_SENT_TO_RECOVERY
values.doc:
The withdrawal's execution failed on its destination network: the net
 went to the bridge's recovery address, which settles it with the
 broker, and the network fee was kept. The debit stands.

values.name: CLOSE_UNKNOWN
values.doc:
The withdrawal failed, and where its funds went is not known: the
 payout ended before payouts recorded how a failed withdrawal closed, its
 outcome was not known when it ended, or the records of its end disagree. The payout may have left the vault or
 may have been returned to it; the vault's balance is authoritative.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.PayoutConversion
types.doc:
PayoutConversion is one asset a payout run converts into its rule's
 payout asset through a Swap placed from the vault, before it pays.
 Amounts are in base units of 18 decimals.

fields.name: source_asset_id
fields.doc:
Asset converted, as an AssetConfig.ledger_id from
 GET /v1/chain/deposit-withdraw/config.

fields.name: payout_asset_id
fields.doc: Payout asset the conversion delivers, as an AssetConfig.ledger_id.

fields.name: amount
fields.doc:
Amount of the source asset the conversion spends: the vault's whole
 available balance of it when the run planned.

fields.name: swap_id
fields.doc:
Public ID of the conversion's Swap; zero when the asset was not
 converted.

fields.name: execution
fields.doc: Market or TWAP; unset when the asset was not converted.

fields.name: status
fields.doc: Where the Swap stands; unset when the asset was not converted.

fields.name: reason
fields.doc:
Why a terminal Swap did not trade its whole amount; unset when it did or
 when the asset was not converted.

fields.name: is_terminal
fields.doc: Whether the conversion is over: its Swap is terminal, or it was skipped.

fields.name: executed_amount
fields.doc: Source asset spent, settled; zero until the Swap is terminal.

fields.name: unspent_amount
fields.doc: Source asset that stays in the vault: amount minus executed_amount.

fields.name: received_amount
fields.doc: Payout asset received after fees; zero until the Swap is terminal.

fields.name: skip_reason
fields.doc:
Why the asset was not converted: route_unsupported (no route converts
 it into the payout asset), below_minimum, above_maximum,
 conversion_unavailable (the route's depth cannot meet the conversion's
 slippage protection now), price_unavailable (no current price valued
 it), conversion_refused, rule_superseded or policy_denied (the rule's
 author may no longer convert or withdraw from the vault); empty
 otherwise. Its balance stays in the vault.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.PayoutRuleDestination
types.doc:
PayoutRuleDestination pays one asset of a vault, in kind, to one address.
 Amounts are in base units of 18 decimals.

fields.name: asset_id
fields.doc:
Asset paid, as an AssetConfig.ledger_id from
 GET /v1/chain/deposit-withdraw/config.

fields.name: destination_chain_id
fields.doc: Destination chain identifier.

fields.name: destination_address
fields.doc: Canonical destination address.

fields.name: min_amount
fields.doc: A run pays the asset only when the payable amount reaches this minimum.

fields.name: max_amount
fields.doc: The most one run pays the asset; the rest stays in the vault.

fields.name: min_floor
fields.doc:
The least one payout to this destination can pay now: the network's
 withdrawal minimum, and more than its current network fee. It follows
 the network fee. Unset when the network or its fee is not known now.

fields.name: estimated_network_fee
fields.doc:
The network fee a payout to this destination is expected to be charged,
 from the network's latest sampled fee: an estimate, not the fee charged
 (PayoutStep.charged_network_fee). Unset when it is not known now.

fields.name: estimated_network_fee_sampled_at
fields.doc: When estimated_network_fee was sampled; unset with it.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.PayoutStage
types.doc:
PayoutStage is where an in-progress payout run stands. A run moves through
 the stages in this order: STAGE_PLANNING, STAGE_CONVERTING (only on a rule
 with a payout asset), STAGE_REQUESTING, STAGE_PROCESSING, STAGE_BROADCAST.
 STAGE_CONVERTING comes after STAGE_PLANNING and before STAGE_REQUESTING,
 although its number is 5.

values.name: STAGE_PLANNING
values.doc: Reading the vault's balances to size the payouts.

values.name: STAGE_REQUESTING
values.doc: A payout is waiting to be requested or being requested.

values.name: STAGE_PROCESSING
values.doc:
Every payout due was accepted; no destination-network transaction is
 known yet.

values.name: STAGE_BROADCAST
values.doc:
A destination-network transaction is known (PayoutStep.tx_hash); the run
 waits for its withdrawals to complete.

values.name: STAGE_CONVERTING
values.doc:
The run is converting the vault's other assets into the rule's payout
 asset (Payout.conversions); its payout step is planned once every
 conversion is over and settled.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.PayoutStatus
types.doc:
PayoutStatus is what one payout run of a broker vault came to, from the
 run and the outcome of each of its assets.

values.name: PAYOUT_PAID
values.doc:
The run paid: every asset with a payable amount was withdrawn and its
 withdrawal completed on its destination network.

values.name: PAYOUT_PARTIALLY_PAID
values.doc:
Some assets were paid and at least one failed; reason is the first
 failed asset's, and each step shows its own outcome.

values.name: PAYOUT_IN_PROGRESS
values.doc: The run is under way; stage says where.

values.name: PAYOUT_ROLLED_OVER
values.doc:
Nothing was paid, and the balance stays in the vault for the next run.
 reason is nothing_to_pay (no asset reached its minimum), below_minimum
 (an amount was below the least a withdrawal on its network pays),
 price_unavailable (the rule has a USD minimum and no current price
 valued an asset), destination_cooling_down (the destination was added
 to the vault's external withdraw whitelist less than 24 hours ago),
 route_suspended (withdrawals to the destination's network were
 suspended) or supply_unavailable (the destination route's zToken supply
 was not known or not current). Each
 step carries the balance evaluated, its value and the minimum it was
 held to.

values.name: PAYOUT_HELD
values.doc:
Nothing was paid because the rule stopped paying, and the balance stays
 in the vault. reason is rule_superseded (the rule was paused, changed or
 replaced before the run paid), or destination_not_whitelisted,
 destination_invalid or authority_revoked, with which the rule paused
 itself (see VaultPayoutRule.pause); an Owner or Finance member resumes
 it.

values.name: PAYOUT_FAILED
values.doc:
Nothing was paid, and at least one asset's payout failed; reason is the
 first failure's: withdrawal_refused (refused before any funds left the
 vault), gateway_capacity_insufficient (the funds stay for a later run),
 withdrawal_released (released before it was sent; nothing left the
 vault) or withdrawal_failed (the withdrawal ended without paying, before
 or after it reached the destination network). Each step's close
 (PayoutStep.close, as ListVaultLedger shows it) says where the funds of
 a withdrawal that left the vault went; a withdrawal_failed step whose
 close was not recorded reads CLOSE_UNKNOWN, never a guess. The step's
 tx_hash, when set, is its destination-network transaction.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.PayoutStep
types.doc:
PayoutStep is one asset's payout in a run. Amounts are in base units of 18
 decimals.

fields.name: asset_id
fields.doc:
Asset paid, as an AssetConfig.ledger_id from
 GET /v1/chain/deposit-withdraw/config.

fields.name: destination_chain_id
fields.doc: Destination chain identifier.

fields.name: destination_address
fields.doc: Canonical destination address.

fields.name: state
fields.doc: Where the payout stands.

fields.name: reason
fields.doc:
Machine-readable reason of a skipped or failed step: below_minimum,
 price_unavailable, rule_superseded, destination_not_whitelisted,
 destination_cooling_down (the destination was added to the vault's
 external withdraw whitelist less than 24 hours ago; the balance stays
 for a later run), route_suspended (withdrawals to the destination's
 network were suspended; the balance stays for a later run),
 supply_unavailable (the destination route's zToken supply was not known
 or not current; the balance stays for a later run),
 destination_invalid, authority_revoked,
 withdrawal_refused,
 gateway_capacity_insufficient, withdrawal_released (the withdrawal was
 released before it was sent; nothing left the vault) or
 withdrawal_failed (the withdrawal ended without paying; close says
 where its funds went, see PAYOUT_FAILED); empty otherwise.

fields.name: available
fields.doc: The vault's available balance of the asset when the run started.

fields.name: amount
fields.doc:
What the step pays: the available balance up to the rule's per-run
 ceiling, rounded down to whole units of the destination network. Zero
 when skipped. The network fee is taken out of it on the way.

fields.name: minimum
fields.doc:
The least amount the rule pays for the asset (the destination's minimum
 in the rule version the run executed). A withdrawal on the network may
 need more, as below_minimum says.

fields.name: value_usd
fields.doc:
USD value of the payable amount when the run started, checked against
 Payout.min_usd_value; unset when the rule has no USD minimum or no
 current price valued the asset.

fields.name: tx_hash
fields.doc: Destination-network transaction hash, once known.

fields.name: charged_network_fee
fields.doc:
The network fee charged on the withdrawal. On a completed step it was
 taken out of amount, so the destination received amount minus this fee.
 On a failed step whose withdrawal the destination network's bridge
 rejected or failed to execute, it is the fee kept, which is not
 refunded. Unset until the step is final, on a skipped step or one that
 failed before reaching that bridge, and when the fee was not reported;
 never zero for unknown.

fields.name: close
fields.doc:
How the step's withdrawal ended once it left the vault, the same close
 as the step's PAYOUT_DEBIT entry in ListVaultLedger: CLOSE_PAID for a
 completed step; for a failed one CLOSE_REFUNDED_TO_SMART_ACCOUNT,
 CLOSE_SENT_TO_RECOVERY, or CLOSE_UNKNOWN when where its funds went is
 not known. Unset (CLOSE_UNSPECIFIED) while the step is not final, and on
 a step that never left the vault, such as a skipped, refused, held or
 released one.

fields.name: refunded_amount
fields.doc:
The net the destination network's bridge refunded to the vault's own
 smart account, the amount of the step's PAYOUT_REFUND entry; set only
 with CLOSE_REFUNDED_TO_SMART_ACCOUNT, never zero for unknown.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.PayoutStepState
types.doc: PayoutStepState is where one asset's payout in a run stands.

values.name: PAYOUT_STEP_PENDING
values.doc: Planned; not yet requested.

values.name: PAYOUT_STEP_REQUESTING
values.doc: Being requested.

values.name: PAYOUT_STEP_SUBMITTED
values.doc:
The withdrawal was accepted and waits to complete on its destination
 network.

values.name: PAYOUT_STEP_COMPLETED
values.doc: The withdrawal completed on its destination network.

values.name: PAYOUT_STEP_FAILED
values.doc: The payout failed; reason says why (see PAYOUT_FAILED).

values.name: PAYOUT_STEP_SKIPPED
values.doc:
Nothing was paid for this asset in this run; reason says why, and the
 balance stays in the vault.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.Protection
types.doc:
Protection bounds the worst execution the end user accepts. It is fixed when
 the QuickSwap is created and is enforced on every execution, however long
 after the quote the deposit arrives.

fields.name: max_slippage_bps
fields.doc:
Maximum shortfall from the quoted expected output in basis points
 (1 bp = 0.01%), from 1 to 1000. Converted at creation into the quote's
 min_amount_out and min_rate.

fields.name: min_amount_out
fields.doc:
Positive minimum destination amount after fees for the quoted deposit
 amount, in destination token units. Converted at creation into the
 quote's min_rate.

cel.message: min_amount_out must be positive

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.QuickSwap
types.doc:
QuickSwap is one broker-owned swap of an external deposit into external
 withdrawals. The end user needs no account.

fields.name: swap_id
fields.doc: Public QuickSwap identifier.

fields.name: idempotency_key
fields.doc: The broker's idempotency key that created this QuickSwap.

fields.name: status
fields.doc: Current status.

fields.name: reason
fields.doc:
Why the status is notable (held, returning, delayed, terminal without
 destination output); REASON_UNSPECIFIED otherwise. When a payout
 completes but a refund or return was NOT_SENT, the status follows the
 paid withdrawals (for example COMPLETED) and the reason is
 REFUND_BELOW_MINIMUM. A FAILED withdrawal takes precedence: the status is
 HELD and the reason WITHDRAWAL_FAILED.

fields.name: is_terminal
fields.doc:
True when status is terminal; authoritative, including for status values
 added later. Polling can stop at a terminal status. A terminal status
 never changes. Shortly after it, address_retires_at can still move later,
 and withdrawal details can be corrected as documented on Withdrawal;
 another deposit reaching the address, before or after it retired, also
 shows as RETURN_ONLY. Such a deposit is returned directly, not through
 withdrawals: its direct_return reports the return, and RETURN_ONLY alone
 does not confirm a completed return.
 An EXPIRED QuickSwap whose dropped or replaced deposit confirms after all
 becomes HELD (see QuickSwapStatus.EXPIRED). Read again if the end user
 reports such a deposit or needs the final retirement time.

fields.name: terms
fields.doc: Accepted economic terms.

fields.name: destination_address
fields.doc:
Recipient of the swap output on the destination network. Addresses and
 memos are in their network's canonical form (for example lowercase EVM
 hex), which can differ in case or encoding from the create request; that
 form is the one paid.

fields.name: destination_memo
fields.doc: Destination tag or memo for destination_address; empty when none.

fields.name: return_address
fields.doc: Recipient of returned source funds on the source network.

fields.name: return_memo
fields.doc: Destination tag or memo for return_address; empty when none.

fields.name: refund_zipped_asset_id
fields.doc:
Refund route (asset and network) of the intermediate asset; zero when
 none was supplied.

fields.name: refund_address
fields.doc: Recipient of refunded intermediate asset; empty when none was supplied.

fields.name: refund_memo
fields.doc: Destination tag or memo for refund_address; empty when none.

fields.name: quote
fields.doc:
Quote and protection fixed at creation. Not refreshed on retries. Its
 amounts and fees stay estimates: the QuickSwap is priced when its deposit
 is credited, and execution, withdrawals and charged_fees report the
 actual output and fees.

fields.name: deposit_instructions
fields.doc:
Where and until when to deposit; absent while ALLOCATING and on a
 QuickSwap that never got an address (REJECTED, or EXPIRED with
 DEPOSIT_ADDRESS_CONFLICT).

fields.name: screening
fields.doc: Risk screening.

fields.name: deposits
fields.doc:
Detected deposits, oldest first, at most 50. A deposit detected earlier
 can appear later and shift the others' index (see Deposit.index).

fields.name: deposits_truncated
fields.doc:
True when more than 50 deposits were detected; only the first 50 are
 listed.

fields.name: execution
fields.doc: Execution progress; absent before execution starts.

fields.name: withdrawals
fields.doc: Withdrawals, oldest first, at most 50.

fields.name: withdrawals_truncated
fields.doc: True when more than 50 withdrawals exist; only the first 50 are listed.

fields.name: created_at
fields.doc: When the QuickSwap was created.

fields.name: updated_at
fields.doc: When the QuickSwap last changed.

fields.name: terminal_at
fields.doc: When status became terminal; unset while not terminal.

fields.name: version
fields.doc:
Monotonic state version: a snapshot with a lower version is older. Zero
 while ALLOCATING; 1 once the deposit address is issued (AWAITING_DEPOSIT),
 allocation ends without one (EXPIRED with DEPOSIT_ADDRESS_CONFLICT) or
 the QuickSwap is REJECTED; every later change increments it.

fields.name: fee_schedule_version
fields.doc:
Fee schedule version fixed at creation. Every execution or bridge payout
 of this QuickSwap is charged that version's service fees, capped by the
 broker's fee ceiling in force at creation if one applies, whatever later
 versions or ceiling changes make.

fields.name: fees
fields.doc:
Broker and affiliate fees as requested, fixed at creation. With a
 referral (quote.referral), the broker fee charged is broker_bps less the
 referral's discount and commission.

fields.name: charged_fees
fields.doc:
Service, broker, affiliate and referral fees charged so far, as
